title: Retain an actual prefix history without a hidden conditional sampler
statement: For supplied finite causal prefix branches A_r with actual available adjoint factors, b_r=P_ur^* A_r^* f and c_r=P_vr^* A_r^* f. Freeze positive design q_r on replaced branches and execute the reference elsewhere. The actual chronological prefix/reverse-prefix report acquires D_q=sum ||b_r-c_r||^2/q_r, and joint retained-record/state/common-future TV<=sqrt(D_q)/2. The forward branch probability is counted once; q is not an invented deployment frequency and each hidden conditional state is not copied or sampled.

assumptions: The theorem compares reachable preparations on the same included state space under a common conditional future law; it does not identify an unknown future device or arbitrary dark input. Every reentering bath, log, clock and selector must be jointly qualified or actually isolated/reset. Endpoint coin error zeta costs 2zeta in the witness. Retained hidden conditional inputs require the actual instrument-adjoint receiver; visible endpoint functions cannot stand for unknown hidden densities. Exact equality is not acquired from finite positive point estimates.
